gloss: to persuade; to hit on, to seduce

definitions.gloss: to persuade, to talk into, to win over
definitions.explanation: To persistently try to convince someone to agree or comply. Often implies repeated or prolonged attempts.

definitions.gloss: to hit on, to make a pass at, to court
definitions.explanation: To try to win someone's romantic interest through persistent attention or flattery.

examples.japanese: {友人|ゆうじん}を{口説|くど}いて{参加|さんか}させた。
examples.english: I persuaded my friend to participate.

examples.japanese: {何度|なんど}も{口説|くど}いてやっと{承諾|しょうだく}してもらった。
examples.english: After persuading them many times, I finally got their agreement.

examples.japanese: {社長|しゃちょう}を{口説|くど}いてプロジェクトの{予算|よさん}を{増|ふ}やしてもらった。
examples.english: I talked the president into increasing the project budget.

examples.japanese: バーで{女性|じょせい}を{口説|くど}く。
examples.english: To hit on a woman at a bar.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}は{口説|くど}くのが{上手|うま}い。
examples.english: He's good at hitting on people.

examples.japanese: {半年|はんとし}かけて{彼女|かのじょ}を{口説|くど}き{落|お}とした。
examples.english: He spent half a year wooing her and finally won her over.

notes:
Both senses share the nuance of persistent, repeated attempts to win someone over. Sense 2 is especially common in casual conversation.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・{口説|くど}き{落|お}とす — to successfully woo/persuade (implies success after effort)
・{口説|くど}き{文句|もんく} — pickup line, sweet talk
・{何度|なんど}も{口説|くど}く — to persuade/court repeatedly

SIMILAR WORDS:
・{説得|せっとく}する — to persuade (more neutral and formal)
・ナンパする — to pick up, to hit on (more casual, street-oriented)
